name: WPTelMessage
author: HRCode

sections.description:
The WPTelMessage plugin works with contact forms such as Contact Form 7, WPForms, and NinjaForms.
You can also configure the WPTelMessage plugin to work with WooCommerce, allowing you to receive notifications in Telegram about orders in your store and respond to them promptly.

The WPTelMessage plugin has minimal settings; all you need to do is specify your Telegram group number and the token of your Telegram bot. After that, you only need to activate the contact form from which you want to receive messages.
If you are using the WooCommerce plugin, in addition to activating the message reception feature, you will also need to enable the necessary notifications for orders or products.

Additional Info

Resources used by the WPTelMessage plugin

The WPTelMessage plugin uses the Telegram API (https://core.telegram.org/api) for its operation.
The token number and chat ID you specified are required for the plugin to work and will be sent to the Telegram servers.
Messages from contact forms and the WooCommerce plugin will also be sent to the Telegram servers.

You can read the Telegram API terms of use and Telegram privacy policy here: https://telegram.org/privacy/ru
sections.faq:
Is the plugin ready to work immediately after activation?

Yes, the plugin is ready to work immediately after activation.

Once the plugin is activated, it is ready to start receiving messages from your website contact forms and sending them to the specified Telegram group.

Just make sure that you have configured the plugin settings correctly, such as the bot token (Bot Token) and group ID (Group ID).

Once the plugin is activated and the settings are configured, it is ready to work immediately and will start sending messages to your Telegram group when it receives data from contact forms and WooCommerce.
